scares.description: There is a very loud bang on the door, followed by some rattling and clanking noises over the next few minutes.
Kristen opens the curtains and sees a masked man in the window.
Kristen peeks behind the door and sees a dolls mask.
A hand comes into view from behind James while he is in car.
Kristen grabs James as he steps back inside the house.
There is a loud bang on the bedroom window followed by several more over the next few seconds.
James is standing in front of the door when a loud bang is heard.
A rock is thrown through Mike’s wind-shield.
James shoots Mike with a shotgun.
A metallic noise is heard while Kristen is in the shed.
There are several loud clattering and banging noises over the next minute or so.
A masked woman appears from behind the table.
The masked woman suddenly appears in front of Kristen while she is hiding.
The masked man grabs Kristen as she walks into the hallway.
Kristen screams as she is dragged away.
Kristen screams and grabs onto one of the Mormon boys.
